what.text: This page follows refugees from Togo living in Germany, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 845 Togolese refugees in Germany, 6.7% of all refugees from Togo.
Benin hosts the most Togolese refugees, followed by Ghana, France and Germany.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Togo: over the government, with JNIM, from 2022 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2002 to 2012, come before that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 5743 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 5988, at the end of 2005, and has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Germany.
These are year-end totals for Germany only, reported to UNHCR.
